tickets.text: There’s a stray cat sitting outside the office window.
The lights in the parking lot are flickering at night.
I accidentally brought my personal laptop instead of my work one.
There’s a birthday cake in the break room fridge if anyone wants some.
A car alarm has been going off outside the building for over an hour.
Someone left a mysterious box by the reception desk.
I spilled coffee on my desk, now my keyboard isn't working.
There’s a weird smell coming from the supply closet.
I need to find out who owns the red umbrella in the lobby.
There’s loud construction noise outside making it hard to concentrate.
There’s a group of people protesting outside the building entrance.
Someone’s pet dog wandered into the office today.
